## Cross-check done

- [ ] I checked the new source URL is accessible
- [ ] The new quote is verbatim (not paraphrased)
- [ ] The attribution is accurate (verified via search)
- [ ] I noted the old citation's `lastVerified` date (for stale-flag analysis)

---

## Why this matters

Per our quality bar, every citation must be primary-source verified. Stale or wrong citations erode trust — the Wiki's main moat.
